import os, datetime
from datetime import datetime as dt

# login to file_system
creds = {c['account_name']: c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
fs_access = apis.file_system.login(username='paul_mill@gmail.com', password=creds['file_system'])['access_token']

vac_dir = '~/photographs/vacations/'
file_paths = apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path=vac_dir, entry_type='files', recursive=True, access_token=fs_access)
print('file_count', len(file_paths))

now_year = dt.now().year
print('now_year', now_year)

# collect month/year for each file
info = []
for p in file_paths:
    f = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=p, access_token=fs_access)
    created = f.get('created_at')
    # created_at like '2019-01-01T00:00:00'
    cdt = dt.fromisoformat(created)
    info.append((p, cdt.year, cdt.month, os.path.basename(p)))

# classify
petra = [x for x in info if x[1]==now_year and x[2]==2]
budapest = [x for x in info if x[1]==now_year and x[2]==3]
amsterdam = [x for x in info if not (x[1]==now_year and x[2] in (2,3))]

print('petra_count', len(petra))
print('budapest_count', len(budapest))
print('amsterdam_count', len(amsterdam))

print('sample_petra', [os.path.basename(x[0]) for x in petra[:5]])
print('sample_budapest', [os.path.basename(x[0]) for x in budapest[:5]])
print('sample_amsterdam', [os.path.basename(x[0]) for x in amsterdam[:5]])

# print full lists for verification (filenames only)
print('petra_files', [x[3] for x in petra])
print('budapest_files', [x[3] for x in budapest])
print('amsterdam_files', [x[3] for x in amsterdam])

import os
from datetime import datetime

# login to file_system
creds = {c['account_name']: c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
fs_access = apis.file_system.login(username='paul_mill@gmail.com', password=creds['file_system'])['access_token']

vac_dir = '~/photographs/vacations'

# Create destination directories
for d in ['Petra','Budapest','Amsterdam']:
    apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path=f"{vac_dir}/{d}/", access_token=fs_access, recursive=True, allow_if_exists=True)

# Recompute classifications (month/year)
file_paths = apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path=vac_dir+'/', entry_type='files', recursive=True, access_token=fs_access)
now_year = datetime.now().year

petra_files = []
budapest_files = []
amsterdam_files = []

for p in file_paths:
    f = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=p, access_token=fs_access)
    created = f.get('created_at')
    cdt = datetime.fromisoformat(created)
    base = os.path.basename(p)
    if cdt.year==now_year and cdt.month==2:
        petra_files.append(base)
    elif cdt.year==now_year and cdt.month==3:
        budapest_files.append(base)
    else:
        amsterdam_files.append(base)

print('counts', {'Petra':len(petra_files),'Budapest':len(budapest_files),'Amsterdam':len(amsterdam_files)})

# Build map base->source path (since all are in root)
# Ensure we locate actual full paths
source_by_base = {os.path.basename(p):p for p in file_paths}

# Move each file
results = {'Petra':[], 'Budapest':[], 'Amsterdam':[]}

for spot, bases in [('Petra',petra_files),('Budapest',budapest_files),('Amsterdam',amsterdam_files)]:
    for base in bases:
        src = source_by_base[base]
        dst = f"{vac_dir}/{spot}/{base}"
        try:
            r = apis.file_system.move_file(source_file_path=src, destination_file_path=dst, access_token=fs_access, overwrite=False, retain_dates=True)
            results[spot].append((base,'ok',r.get('destination_file_path',dst)))
        except Exception as e:
            results[spot].append((base,'fail',str(e)))

# Print summary
for spot in ['Petra','Budapest','Amsterdam']:
    ok = [x for x in results[spot] if x[1]=='ok']
    fail = [x for x in results[spot] if x[1]=='fail']
    print(spot,'moved_ok',len(ok),'fail',len(fail))
    if fail:
        print('sample_fail',fail[:3])

# Verify: list each directory files (non-recursive)
for spot in ['Petra','Budapest','Amsterdam']:
    files = apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path=f"{vac_dir}/{spot}/", entry_type='files', recursive=False, access_token=fs_access)
    print('verify',spot,'file_count',len(files))
